name: s4-orion
description: S4 Orion: a personal design language on Material 3 Expressive, with a glass layer for floating chrome.

scripts.build: npm run build:tokens && node scripts/build-gray.mjs && npm run build:icons && npm run build:bundle
scripts.check: npm run check:tokens && npm run check:gray && npm run check:icons && npm run check:glass && npm run check:accent && npm run check:scopes && npm run check:motion && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test: npm run test:suite && npm run test:pages && npm run test:reach
